title: Bookkeeping categories (v1)
source: Buwiz_Tax_Profiles_Categories_Form_Fields.xlsx, sheet 'Category catalog' rows 6-64 (59 categories), plus 3 PH control accounts added by correction 21 (rows 65-67). Corrections in research/spreadsheet-corrections.md.
books_reference: Books repo HEAD 1662ca3 (read-only): base.ts and ph-chart.ts keys and numbers (sheets.md s4, verify.md s2 #39-40).
status: Categories are PROPOSAL except where marked CONFIRMED. Keys and numbers marked REUSE match Books exactly. Revised for ADR-0007: default_tax_attributes became default_line_attributes (accounting facts only), each category lists the measures it typically feeds, and the workbook's form links are kept as workbook_form_links (research trail; the Books mapping lives in data/rules/*.rules.json).

selection_logic.description: Workbook selection formula (identical in all 59 rows). A category is CORE when its activation rule is Always. It is SUGGESTED when a profile switch matches its activation rule, otherwise OPTIONAL.

rules.PT: Shown when Profile C7 = Yes (2551Q selected).
rules.PAYROLL: Shown when Profile C8 = Yes (1601-C selected).
rules.IT: Shown when an income-tax form is selected: Profile C9 (1701-MS), G6 (1701Q), G7 (1702 group) or G10 (1701/1701A).
rules.IT_OR_PAYROLL: Shown when C8 = Yes (1601-C) or any income-tax form is selected (C9, G6, G7, G10).
rules.EWT: Shown when Profile G9 = Yes (0619-E or 1601-EQ).

selection_logic.limitation: The profile does not separate 8% from graduated income tax, and does not read C11-C15 (sheets.md s1.1, s8 #3).
selection_logic.hint_only: The activation rules read the linked tax profile's registered-forms list (2551Q, 1601-C, 1701-MS, ...). That list is a HINT for which categories to suggest. It is never an election decision: categories never depend on 8% versus graduated, OSD versus itemized, or VAT status (ADR-0007).

type_mapping.note: Books account types are asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense, cost_of_revenue, other_income, other_expense (src/db/schema/account-constants.ts:9-18, re-read by W2).
